label: October 2026
notes: Facebook: waiting on page access. Facebook posts go out once the page grants access; TikTok posts as scheduled.
All times are Eastern Time. Verses are quoted from the KJV. October starts Wed Oct 21.

Music: each post lists a background-music style. At posting time a matching track is picked from TikTok’s commercial sound library; for clips it sits low (10-15%) under the sermon audio. To change it, leave a note like “music: something more upbeat.”

posts.title: Verse: Acts 4:31
posts.caption: The early church didn’t pray for the pressure to go away. They prayed for boldness, and God answered. What would you ask Him for today?
posts.music: soft ambient piano with a gentle swell, hopeful

posts.title: Prayer prompt: who are you praying will know Jesus?
posts.caption: Some of us have prayed for the same person for years. You don’t have to carry that alone. Comment a first name or an initial, and our church family will pray with you this week.

posts.title: Clip: “Jesus is still at work”
posts.caption: Peter and John were locked up, and people were still saying yes to Jesus. That’s what we mean by UNSTOPPABLE: hard things happen to the messenger, but God keeps working through His message. — from “Bold Witness.”
posts.clipNote: Starts “Jesus’s name is already been heard” → ends “he keeps working, he’s constantly working.” (~66s)

posts.title: Quote: “He depended on the Holy Spirit”
posts.caption: Peter stood before the same council that condemned Jesus, with no degree and no notes. A Spirit-filled answer doesn’t remove the opposition, but it gives courage and the words to say what needs to be said.

posts.title: Carousel: Who decides what you say?
posts.caption: The council gave Peter and John one rule: stop talking about Jesus. Swipe for what they noticed, what they answered, and the quiet trap most of us fall into.

posts.title: Verse: Psalm 46:10
posts.caption: End the day here. He is God, and you don’t have to be. Be still tonight.

posts.title: Welcome: your first Sunday starts here
posts.caption: Thinking about visiting First Alliance? Sundays are at 10:15 AM at 403 S. Progress Ave in Harrisburg. You can let us know you’re coming through Plan a Visit at firstalliancehbg.com. Come as you are.

posts.title: Church family: many cultures, one family
posts.caption: On the first day of the church, everyone heard the good news in their own language. That still happens at First Alliance: different cultures, languages, and stories, one family of faith.
posts.music: bright feel-good acoustic with light world percussion, warm

posts.title: Clip: “Wait and pray”
posts.caption: Some of us have been trying to manufacture our own “suddenly” moment. It’s not ours to work up. It’s hard? Wait and pray. It’s too long? Wait and pray. — from “The Birth of the Church.”
posts.sermon: UNSTOPPABLE, Week 1: The Birth of the Church (Acts 2)
posts.clipNote: Starts “Now, this is for us at First Alliance Church” → ends “whatever it is, you wait and pray.” (~61s)

posts.title: Verse: Psalm 122:1
posts.caption: Who could you say this to tomorrow? “Let’s go to church together.” Sometimes that’s all it takes.

posts.title: Saturday reminder: see you tomorrow
posts.caption: See you tomorrow at 10:15 AM! UNSTOPPABLE continues in the book of Acts. 403 S. Progress Ave, Harrisburg. Bring a friend.
posts.confirm: Inferred: Oct 25 is UNSTOPPABLE week 3 (series began Oct 11; November says it continues Nov 1).

posts.title: See you Sunday · UNSTOPPABLE
posts.caption: Good morning! We gather at 10:15 AM as UNSTOPPABLE continues in the book of Acts. Come as you are, and bring someone with you.

posts.title: Carousel: Jesus belongs in the answer
posts.caption: When someone asks how you made it through, Jesus belongs in the answer. Swipe through, then think of one person who has asked.

posts.title: Clip: “So convinced”
posts.caption: Peter and John were regular people like you and me. The difference? They were so convinced that Jesus was who He said He was, nothing could change that. — from “Bold Witness.”
posts.clipNote: Starts “Here’s the key difference” → ends “it wasn’t by their own sheer strength.” (~64s)

posts.title: Verse: Romans 15:13
posts.caption: A Monday prayer for you: joy, peace, and more hope than you started the week with. Not by trying harder, but by the power of the Holy Spirit.

posts.title: Carousel: When God feels slow
posts.caption: Ten days. No visible change. The whole church on earth was 120 people in one room, praying. Swipe for what they did while they waited.

posts.title: Quote: “The most neglected tool”
posts.caption: Pastor Ricardo said it plainly: “I am guilty of this.” So are most of us. What if prayer were the first thing we reached for this week instead of the last?

posts.title: Family Fun Fest: Saturday, Oct 31, 6-8 PM
posts.caption: Save the date! Family Fun Fest is Saturday, October 31, 6-8 PM at First Alliance Church, 403 S. Progress Ave. It’s free, with dinner, candy, games, and activities for the whole family. No RSVP needed. Bring your neighbors.
posts.confirm: Event details from firstalliancehbg.com/events (checked Oct 20, 2026): the church lists it as “Family Fun Fest,” Sat Oct 31, 6-8 PM, free, dinner, candy, games and activities, no RSVP needed. Confirm the name (brief said “Family Fun Night”).

posts.title: Verse: Psalm 127:3
posts.caption: Every child is a gift from God. Parents, grandparents, teachers, and every one of us who helps a kid feel seen: thank you.

posts.title: Clip: “Someone is watching”
posts.caption: No kids? No grandkids? You are still shaping someone. They’re sitting two rows behind you, watching how you respond when things don’t go your way. — from “What Are You Passing On?”
posts.music: gentle acoustic guitar, warm and encouraging
posts.sermon: What Are You Passing On? (Proverbs 22:6; Ephesians 6:4)
posts.clipNote: Starts “And some of you are not raising anyone” → ends “so behave better.” (~63s)

posts.title: Quote: “I am the way”
posts.caption: It can sound narrow, but He gets to set the rule. There is salvation in no one else, and that is good news for sinners like you and me.

posts.title: Prayer prompt: how can we pray for your family?
posts.caption: Whatever your family looks like right now, you don’t have to carry it alone. Tell us how we can pray, in the comments or by private message.

posts.title: Carousel: What “unstoppable” means
posts.caption: UNSTOPPABLE isn’t a word about us. Swipe for what it means, and what it doesn’t.

posts.title: Verse: Psalm 133:1
posts.caption: There’s nothing quite like a church family that actually likes being together. Grateful for ours.

posts.title: Church family: the door is open
posts.caption: Walking into a new church can feel like a lot. You won’t walk in alone. Someone will be at the door on Sunday to say hello. 10:15 AM, 403 S. Progress Ave.

posts.title: Clip: “Same Peter, new power”
posts.caption: Not long ago, Peter denied Jesus three times to a servant girl. Now he stands in front of Jerusalem and preaches. Did he just get smarter? No. The Holy Spirit had come. — from “The Birth of the Church.”
posts.music: hopeful cinematic piano with a soft build
posts.sermon: UNSTOPPABLE, Week 1: The Birth of the Church (Acts 2)
posts.clipNote: Starts “I want you to, before we get into his preaching, think about this” → ends “and he began to preach Jesus.” (~67s)

posts.title: Verse: Acts 4:13
posts.caption: No credentials, no training, and the room could tell they had been with Jesus. Time with Him still shows.

posts.title: Carousel: Family Fun Fest, what to know
posts.caption: Tomorrow night! Family Fun Fest is Saturday, Oct 31, 6-8 PM at First Alliance Church. Free dinner, candy, games, and activities. No RSVP needed. Swipe for the details and tag a family you’d love to see there.
posts.confirm: Event details from firstalliancehbg.com/events (checked Oct 20, 2026): the church lists it as “Family Fun Fest,” Sat Oct 31, 6-8 PM, free, dinner, candy, games and activities, no RSVP needed. Confirm the name (brief said “Family Fun Night”).

posts.title: Clip: “Your good is not enough”
posts.caption: You can be good all you want. You can be nice all you want. We’re a nice church, but nice doesn’t save anybody. Only Jesus does. — from “Bold Witness.”
posts.clipNote: Approximate (caption blocks ~20s): starts near “There is no other way. You can be good all you want”; ends near “Only God acted through his son Jesus Christ… sinners like you and like me.” (~75s). Confirm in/out and trim to ~60s.

posts.title: Family Fun Fest is tonight
posts.caption: It’s today! Family Fun Fest is tonight, 6-8 PM at First Alliance Church, 403 S. Progress Ave. Free dinner, candy, games, and activities for the whole family. No RSVP needed. See you there!
posts.confirm: Event details from firstalliancehbg.com/events (checked Oct 20, 2026): the church lists it as “Family Fun Fest,” Sat Oct 31, 6-8 PM, free, dinner, candy, games and activities, no RSVP needed. Confirm the name (brief said “Family Fun Night”).

posts.title: Verse: Acts 2:39
posts.caption: The promise is for you, for your children, and for those who feel far off. That’s every family we’ll meet tonight.

posts.title: Saturday reminder: see you tomorrow
posts.caption: Tomorrow is Communion Sunday! Join us at 10:15 AM at 403 S. Progress Ave as we gather around the Lord’s Table. Come as you are.
